prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE test image, an original raster illustration asset for the air-conditioner category of a Japanese house-cleaning website. A single generic, unbranded Japanese wall-mounted indoor air conditioner, viewed perfectly straight-on from the front at eye level, centered symmetrically. Style: realistic anime-inspired 3D illustration, with convincing white plastic materials, refined soft cel-like shading, rounded manufactured edges, subtle cool gray depth, crisp detailed rendering; considerably more realistic and dimensional than a flat line icon, but still visibly polished anime-style illustration rather than a photograph. Design an original appliance shape: a smooth gently curved ivory-white front panel with narrow pale silver trim, a clearly open lower outlet and neatly visible dark gray horizontal louvers. To give this a slightly different situation from a plain closed appliance drawing, show it operating gently, with only two or three very subtle short translucent pale-blue air ribbons immediately under the outlet. No person, hands, tools, room, wall, floor, furniture, text, numbers, brand, logo, sticker, watermarks, frame, card UI, or blue footer. Background must be genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha, isolated clean cutout suitable for a white website card, not a painted checkerboard. A square canvas, air-conditioner body occupies approximately 80 percent of canvas width and 32 percent of canvas height; the entire subject including the small air ribbons fits in approximately 42 percent of canvas height, leaving balanced generous clear space above and below. Whole appliance visible, no cropping, no perspective side view, no wide-angle distortion. White body must remain clearly defined when shown on a pure white card. Produce only this single image, not a contact sheet or alternatives.
